# Repository Skills

This repository has a small set of specialized skills that reflect the architecture in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

## Available skills

- `api-development` — ASP.NET Core Web API patterns, DTOs, services, controllers, and repository conventions.
- `blazor-client-development` — Blazor WebAssembly client patterns, typed clients, and browser auth behavior.
- `ef-core-migrations` — EF Core schema work, mappings, migrations, and SQL Server persistence rules.
- `auth-and-authorization` — Identity, JWT, roles, refresh tokens, and API-side enforcement.
- `testing-and-validation` — .NET test execution and verification for changes across the solution.

Use the most specific skill for the task, and keep the repository instructions as the source of truth for build, test, and architecture expectations.
